desc: v1 machines (BRIEF). hzd bindings: {hzd: <core path or brace pattern>[#<Type>.<member path>], fallback?}; member paths follow Ref<> links; [n] index, [Type] = first element of that type. The converter resolves into cache hzd/machines.json; the game uses fallback when a value is missing. TODO cells are owned by svet (_owner).

hzd_internal_name.desc: folder name under models/characters/robots/ and entities/characters/robots/

model_parts.desc: mesh parts; {a,b} = brace expansion of exact names

archetype.desc: guard = patrols and calls; herd = grazes, flees or defends (flee_on_alert); predator = stalks and hunts alone; scavenger = pack that scavenges and fights at range

behaviour.desc: species AI knobs read by game/machines (keys per archetype): patrol, call_on_alert, defend_charge, stalk_speed_mps, stalk_until_m, pounce_range_m, scavenge, radar_ping_radius_m, radar_ping_interval_s, pack_call_radius_m

hzd_health.desc: HZD InitialHealth, informational (HZD damage scale differs from CS2); svet logs it in MODLOG

health.desc: game HP in CS2 damage units (design)

armor_points.desc: CS armor rule vs body hits (systems combat.armor_*); weak spots ignore armor

sight_fov_deg.desc: AIVisualSensor.DirectHeadingAngle (svet: confirm deg/rad and half/full angle)

alert_call_radius_m.desc: alerts other machines in radius; 0 = none (herds use systems suspicion.herd_alert_radius_m)

fight_back_radius_m.desc: fleeing machine attacks if the player is closer; 0 = never

weak_spot_parts.desc: our names; meta.json maps them to bones/meshes

sound_roles.desc: cache hzd/machines/<id>/snd/<role>_<n>; svet maps soundbank entries to roles

content_model.desc: content contract: cache-relative model file of this machine (glb, Godot axes, meters); swapping content = new file + sheet

bone_roles.desc: content contract: role -> bone name in content_model (root, hips, spine, chest, neck, head, eye, tail..., leg_<id>_upper/lower/foot/toe); the game uses roles only

points.desc: content contract: point name -> {bone, offset [x,y,z] in bone space (m), radius? (m), kind weak_spot|attack_origin|fx, part? (weak_spot_parts name)}

anim.desc: procedural animation profile (stroje): run_gait, walk_cycle_s, run_cycle_s, body_tilt_max_deg, turn_in_place_dps, neck_rest_pitch_deg (neutral neck pitch, + down, for heads raised in the bind pose), idle_actions, graze_pose, hit_react, death_fall, attack_poses (pose ids of machine_attacks)
